brief:
Israeli occupation forces opened intense fire Sunday using heavy weapons from the Jezira barracks toward residential neighborhoods and surrounding areas in the village of Ma'aria in the Yarmouk Basin region of western rural Daraa in southern Syria, according to Shehab Wire. The barrage targeted civilian residential zones in the locality as part of what witnesses described as a sustained bombardment.

No immediate reports of casualties or structural damage emerged from the initial account of the incident. The shelling marked the latest in a series of strikes on populated areas across the western countryside of Daraa province, where Israeli military operations have intensified over recent months targeting towns and villages near the Syrian-Israeli border.
